A development version of Parcel Panic for Windows 11 (64-bit).

1. Download **ParcelPanic-Windows-x64.zip** below.
2. Extract it, then open **ParcelPanic/ParcelPanic.exe**.
3. Keep the **assets** folder beside the EXE. No compiler is needed to play.

Includes four levels, colored input queues, parcel hover information, Help / Factory info, and F1–F3 demos that open with sample entries.

This ZIP is built by the Windows workflow. The game is still being refined; native Windows gameplay feedback is welcome.

Use the attached game ZIP to play. GitHub's separate “Source code” downloads contain the project files.
